component.name: CardVertical
component.description: A vertical course card with an image thumbnail, an optional overlay action (favorite toggle or overflow menu), optional progress bar, serif title, and metadata row (duration, certified badge, and a 'Completed' check marker when progress reaches 100). Two image proportions via the size prop: lg uses a portrait 4/5 thumbnail (tall), sm uses a landscape 3/2 thumbnail (short). Used in Saved Courses and Discover carousels. Ships as a preset (`<CardVertical …props />`) built from named parts (`CardVertical.Root`, `.Media`, `.Action`, …) that consumers compose directly for uncommon content (ADR-023). No dark variant — appears on light and elevated backgrounds only.

when: Displaying course cards in a horizontal carousel (Discover, Saved Courses sections)
Use size='lg' (portrait thumbnail) for feature carousels where image impact matters
Use size='sm' (landscape thumbnail) for compact carousels or narrower layout slots
Pass progress when the user has started the course — renders a ProgressBar between image and title

Completed is derived, not a prop: progress >= 100 adds CardVertical.Completed (check Icon + 'Completed') to the meta row after Certified; the full ProgressBar stays. In a parts composition, render <CardVertical.Completed /> inside CardVertical.Meta yourself.
Pass action={<CardVertical.Favorite …/>} when the user can save the course; action={<CardVertical.Menu …/>} for an overflow menu of course actions. Never both.
Compose the parts (CardVertical.Root > Media / Progress / Body) only when the preset can't express the content — e.g. an instructor row or custom meta. Start from a named pattern below.

patterns.name: discover-carousel
patterns.description: A horizontal row of large CardVertical cards in the Discover section, paginated by PaginationArrows.

patterns.name: saved-courses-carousel
patterns.description: A horizontal row of compact CardVertical cards showing in-progress saved courses.
patterns.tree: Box > Inline(gap=md, wrap=false) > [CardVertical(size=sm, progress=65), CardVertical(size=sm, progress=20), ...]

patterns.name: certified-badge
patterns.description: The Icon+Text 'Certified' badge in the metadata row is not exclusive to this component's internal layout — reuse the same composition wherever a certified badge appears outside a Card (e.g. a page's course-detail metadata row). Icon gets its color from a `.badge svg { color: var(--ds-color-icon-subtle); }` rule in a co-located CSS Module, targeting the ancestor per the Icon color rule (.claude/rules/components.md) — never an inline `style={{ color }}` on the wrapping element.
patterns.tree: Inline(as='span', gap='xs', align='center', className=<module>.badge) > [Icon(name='badge-check', size='sm'), Text(as='span', size='metadata', color='subtle')]

patterns.name: default-card
patterns.description: Gallery state: large card, certified, no action. The preset default.

patterns.name: in-progress-card
patterns.description: Gallery state: compact card for a started course in Saved Courses. Story: WithProgress with size=sm.

patterns.name: completed-card
patterns.description: Gallery state: a finished course. Story: Completed. The Completed marker is derived from progress — never pass a separate completed flag.

patterns.name: favorite-saved
patterns.description: Gallery state: large card the user has saved. Favorite is controlled by the app's saved state.
patterns.tree: CardVertical(size=lg, title, duration, certified, action=CardVertical.Favorite(pressed, onPressedChange))

patterns.name: overflow-menu
patterns.description: Gallery state: compact card with a kebab menu of course actions. Items reuse DropdownMenu's items array.

patterns.name: placeholder-favorite
patterns.description: Gallery state: no thumbnailSrc (Image placeholder) with an unsaved favorite.

patterns.name: favorite-progress
patterns.description: Gallery state: compact card that is both saved and started.
patterns.tree: CardVertical(size=sm, title, duration, certified, progress=20, action=CardVertical.Favorite(pressed, onPressedChange))

patterns.name: custom-meta
patterns.description: Gallery state (parts only): Meta holds consumer Text instead of Duration/Certified. The preset deliberately has no metaSlot — compose the parts.
patterns.tree: CardVertical.Root(size=lg) > [CardVertical.Media > CardVertical.Action > CardVertical.Menu(items, onSelect), CardVertical.Body > [CardVertical.Title, CardVertical.Meta > Text(as=span, size=metadata, color=subtle)]]

patterns.name: title-only
patterns.description: Gallery state: compact placeholder card with no meta row (no duration, not certified).

patterns.name: instructor-row
patterns.description: Parts composition: an instructor row between Title and Meta. Body's Stack owns the spacing around it; the row's own layout comes from nested primitives, never from a margin or a layout prop on a part.
patterns.tree: CardVertical.Root(size=lg) > [CardVertical.Media > CardVertical.Action > CardVertical.Favorite, CardVertical.Body > [CardVertical.Title, Inline(gap=sm, align=center, wrap=false) > [Avatar(size=sm), Stack(gap=xs) > [Text(as=span, size=metadata), Text(as=span, size=metadata, color=subtle)]], CardVertical.Meta > [CardVertical.Duration, CardVertical.Certified]]]

patterns.name: grouped-meta
patterns.description: Parts composition: Meta keeps its sm spacing while a nested Inline(gap=xs) groups a badge with its date more tightly.
patterns.tree: CardVertical.Root(size=sm) > [CardVertical.Media, CardVertical.Body > [CardVertical.Title, CardVertical.Meta > [CardVertical.Duration, Inline(gap=xs, align=center) > [Badge(label=New), Text(as=span, size=metadata, color=subtle)]]]]

antiPatterns.scenario: Mixing CardVertical and CardHorizontal in the same list
antiPatterns.reason: Inconsistent layout direction breaks visual rhythm.
antiPatterns.alternative: Pick one orientation per context: CardVertical for carousel grids, CardHorizontal for compact lists.

antiPatterns.reason: Creates doubled surface depth that loses hierarchy meaning.
antiPatterns.alternative: Place CardVertical directly in an Inline or Box layout container.

antiPatterns.reason: The serif title and course metadata row are designed for course items specifically.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use Card with a custom inner layout for other content types.

antiPatterns.scenario: Mixing CardVertical and CardHorizontal in the same carousel or grid row
antiPatterns.reason: CardVertical uses portrait or landscape thumbnails; CardHorizontal uses a fixed square thumbnail. Mixing them produces inconsistent heights and visual noise.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use CardVertical for carousel and discover layouts; use CardHorizontal for list and search layouts. Never mix the two in the same visual row.

antiPatterns.scenario: Two actions on one card (both a Favorite and a Menu)
antiPatterns.reason: Action is a slot that accepts exactly one child; it throws at runtime with two, and both buttons would compete for the same corner.
antiPatterns.alternative: Use CardVertical.Menu and put 'Save' in its items.

antiPatterns.scenario: Adding gap or margin to a part (e.g. <CardVertical.Body gap="lg">, or a margin on content inside Body)
antiPatterns.reason: Parts own the card's rhythm (ADR-023): open parts accept children only, so a layout prop is a TypeScript error, and a margin breaks the shared vertical rhythm.
antiPatterns.alternative: Nest a Stack or Inline inside the open part for custom spacing.

antiPatterns.scenario: Wrapping CardVertical.Root (or the preset) in an <a>
antiPatterns.reason: The Favorite/Menu buttons would become interactive content nested inside a link, which is invalid and confuses keyboard and screen-reader users.
antiPatterns.alternative: If the card must link, put the link on the Title and stretch it over the card, keeping Action as a sibling on top.

antiPatterns.scenario: Using Heading instead of CardVertical.Title inside CardVertical.Body, omitting Title from a parts composition, or rendering two Titles
antiPatterns.reason: Title registers the id that names the article, the Favorite/Menu buttons and the progress bar; a plain Heading leaves them unnamed and loses the card's serif size override. Nothing checks for Title at runtime: without it every aria-labelledby on the card points at a missing id and the buttons read only 'Save' / 'More options'; two Titles duplicate the id. `required` is enforced by layout:validate only.
antiPatterns.alternative: Always render exactly one CardVertical.Title as the first child of CardVertical.Body (set its `as` for the page outline).

antiPatterns.scenario: Rendering a CardVertical part outside CardVertical.Root
antiPatterns.reason: Parts read size and the title id from Root's context and throw without it.
antiPatterns.alternative: Compose parts only inside CardVertical.Root, or use the preset.

antiPatterns.scenario: Putting anything other than a single CardVertical.Action inside CardVertical.Media (e.g. a Badge, text or a second overlay button)
antiPatterns.reason: Media is a fixed part whose only optional child is the Action overlay; it throws on anything else. The overlay corner is sized and positioned for one round icon button. Implementors: a fixed part that renders children must narrow and guard them — `children?: ReactNode` silently turns it into an unchecked slot.
antiPatterns.alternative: Put extra content in CardVertical.Body/Meta; put a second action into CardVertical.Menu's items.

antiPatterns.scenario: Adding a completed/status prop to the preset, or using a Badge to signal completion
antiPatterns.reason: Completion is lifecycle state derived from progress (ADR-025); a separate flag can disagree with the bar (completed with progress=40).
antiPatterns.alternative: Pass progress={100}. Only in a parts composition render <CardVertical.Completed /> inside CardVertical.Meta.

purpose.lg: Portrait thumbnail (aspectRatio 4/5) — tall image suited for feature carousels and Discover sections.
purpose.sm: Landscape thumbnail (aspectRatio 3/2) — shorter image suited for compact carousels or narrower slots.

states.description: Static display card — full image opacity.
Image thumbnail fades to 0.8 opacity on card hover.
ProgressBar renders between image and title when the progress prop is provided.
progress >= 100: the ProgressBar renders full and CardVertical.Completed (check Icon in color.icon.subtle + 'Completed' metadata Text) follows Certified in the meta row (derived — no prop).
No thumbnailSrc provided — Image component renders a neutral grey placeholder with a centred icon.
Favorite's aria-pressed is true; the heart fills with color.icon.brand, keeping the on-media halo.
Menu trigger has aria-expanded=true and a DropdownMenu panel opens below it, right-aligned; focus moves to the first item.

ariaAttributes: role=article on Root, aria-labelledby → the Title's id (Title registers it via context)
thumbnailAlt / Media alt — pass a meaningful description of the course image, or empty string (default) when the title already provides sufficient context.
Favorite: aria-pressed (toggle button); accessible name 'Save <title>' via aria-label='Save' + aria-labelledby=[self, title]

Menu trigger: aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded, aria-controls → the panel while open; accessible name 'More options <title>' via aria-labelledby=[self, title]. Panel is DropdownMenu listRole=menu, named by the same aria-labelledby. No trigger renders when items is empty.
Progress: ProgressBar aria-labelledby → the Title's id

keyboardInteractions.action: Moves focus to the Favorite or Menu button (the card has no other focus stop)
Opens the menu and moves focus to the first item
Selects the item, closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger
Closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger
Closes the menu and lets focus move on; an outside click also closes it without pulling focus back. Home/End and arrow wrapping are out of scope (DropdownMenu's shared contract)

accessibility.notes: Menu focus: only Escape and item selection return focus to the trigger; pointer dismissal (outside click) and Tab/focusout close the menu without moving focus, so focus is never pulled away from where the user put it. aria-expanded must read false after every close path (Escape, selection, outside click, Tab), and Enter and Space must both be tested on items — Space selects on keydown and focus returns before keyup, the path most likely to re-trigger the button. Favorite is controlled-or-uncontrolled like a native input: when `pressed` is passed, aria-pressed follows the prop only, never internal state.

parts.name: Root
parts.description: The article container. Provides size and the title id to every part through context; owns the spacing between Media, Progress and Body.

parts.name: Media
parts.description: Positioned wrapper around Image (aspect 4/5 for lg, 3/2 for sm, from Root's size). Props: src, alt (''), and an optional single Action child (runtime guard throws otherwise — fixed, not slot, because the overlay is optional). No overflow clipping so the Menu panel can extend past it.

parts.name: Action
parts.description: Top-right overlay slot on Media. Exactly one Favorite or Menu; throws otherwise. Maps to the Figma 'Action' instance-swap property.

parts.name: Favorite
parts.description: Round transparent heart Button with an on-media halo toggling aria-pressed. Props: pressed, defaultPressed (false), onPressedChange.

parts.name: Menu
parts.description: Round transparent kebab Button with an on-media halo that opens a DropdownMenu. Props: items (DropdownMenuItem[]), onSelect. Open state is internal (Figma 'Expanded' is design-only).

parts.name: Progress
parts.description: ProgressBar named by the title. Props: value (0–100).

parts.name: Body
parts.description: Stack gap=sm holding Title and the card's text content. Children only — no layout props.

parts.name: Title
parts.description: Heading (headline-serif, subheader size) that registers the title id. Props: as ('h3'), children. Must come first in Body.

parts.name: Meta
parts.description: Inline gap=sm wrap align=center for the metadata row. Children only — nest an Inline to group items more tightly.

parts.name: Completed
parts.description: check Icon (color.icon.subtle) + 'Completed' Text, same styling as Certified. No props. The preset renders it when progress >= 100.
